verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an AI-powered accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of retention settings, account or data deletion, or controls over AI data handling. Data export (CSV/Excel/PDF) is a portability feature, not retention control. Journal-entry edits create voiding entries rather than deleting records, which is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
